parameterization.input: scalar theta; unit quaternion q on S^3; the IFT is solved in the 3-dim orthonormal tangent basis E(q)
parameterization.ift: dq*/dtheta = -E H^{-1} E^T (2 Jv^T dM v2), H = E^T (d^2J - 4 J I) E (3x3 Riemannian Hessian)
parameterization.output: phi = [vec R(q) (row-major, 9); t* = GinvD v2(q) (3)] in R^12
parameterization.metric: relative error = ||analytic - fd||_F / ||fd||_F on the Euclidean R^12 vector; FD perturbs theta, the pose is never differentiated numerically

bpn_local.note: ablation, NOT part of the 4-head protocol: warm-started local Newton (8 iters) + IFT, no enumeration; needs a trusted initial branch and cannot notice a crossing or a fold

throughput.note: mode enumeration is per-sample in this implementation: it is 90-95% of the per-sample fwd+bwd cost for the three enumerating heads, and the CPU loop batch gives no speed-up. A vectorised multi-instance Newton over B different M is not implemented. bpn_local shows the cost if the branch is tracked incrementally (no enumeration), which is the only place a real speed-up is available.

equivalence.note: (a) solves H xi = 2 E^T Jv^T dM v2 by hand at every mode of 20 thetas and reproduces dposes to machine precision, i.e. the hard head's backward already IS the 3x3 Riemannian IFT; (d) the literal 'enumerate + argmin + ift_dq' recipe is therefore identical to the existing hard head, not a new head
